title: Digital AI Business Analyst
description:
Digital AI Business Analyst

Location: Canary Wharf, London / Hybrid working

Salary: Up to £55,000 basic, plus 13% bonus (up to approximately £62,000)

Working pattern: Two days per week in the office - Tuesday plus one other day of your choice

A global organisation is seeking a Digital Business Analyst with experience in AI-assisted development and a strong interest in emerging technologies.

This is an excellent opportunity to join an £18 billion business that offers extensive training and development. You will use AI and low-code tools to rapidly build practical applications, automations and AI solutions, taking them from initial concept and minimum viable product through to secure, production-ready delivery.

The role

Working closely with business stakeholders, infrastructure engineers, governance teams and other Digital Business Analysts, you will:

Translate business requirements into practical digital solutions, prototypes and applications.

Use AI tools to generate, refactor and debug code.

Review and refine AI-generated code to ensure it is accurate, secure and maintainable.

Design and deliver applications and automations across Microsoft 365, Power Platform, SharePoint, Power BI and Azure.

Develop AI initiatives from minimum viable products through to production-ready tools.

Build and deploy collaborative Microsoft 365 solutions, including team workspaces, workflows and document-sharing tools.

Gather and structure high-level business requirements.

Produce process-flow diagrams and concise supporting documentation.

Iterate on solutions with stakeholders to ensure they meet business needs.

Evaluate emerging AI and low-code technologies and assess their potential business value.

Apply data-governance, security and compliance requirements to all solutions.

Support effective handover and adoption across the business.

Skills and experience

You will have experience working as a Business Analyst in a digital or technology-focused environment.

One to two years' practical experience using AI technologies.

Experience building applications and automations with AI-assisted development tools.

The ability to turn plain-language business requirements into working prototypes quickly.

Experience reviewing and validating AI-generated code for correctness, security and maintainability.

Knowledge of Microsoft 365, Power Platform, SharePoint, Power BI and Azure.

Strong stakeholder-management and requirements-gathering skills.

A practical, creative approach to solving business problems.

An understanding of data governance, security and compliance.

The ability to produce clear process maps and concise documentation.

Experience with tools such as Copilot Studio, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, Antigravity, Power Platform AI capabilities and Azure AI Foundry would be advantageous. Familiarity with vibe coding, agent-assisted development or building agents in Azure AI Foundry is also desirable.

Package and location

The role offers:

A basic salary of up to £55,000.

A 13% performance bonus, taking total potential earnings to approximately £62,000.

A potential salary review of up to 10%.

Hybrid working, with two office days per week.

Training and career-development opportunities within a major global organisation.

The Canary Wharf office is accessible from across London and the Home Counties, including Essex, Hertfordshire, Kent, Surrey and Sussex.
